testsuite.name: UC10 Diagnoses
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 . An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has started documenting an office visit, including basic health metrics, for the patient [UC7 & UC8].

step.actions: hcp: The HCP selects the correct diagnosis from the menu of diagnoses options labeled by their ICD-10 codes and descriptions. They enter the following additional information about the diagnosis: the date of the office visit, HCP who diagnosed patient, and any notes. They press the Save Diagnosis button .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message shows if the diagnosis was documented correctly.
